summary: Pulse Phase 2 Employee Profile, @mentions, Permissions testing complete. Backend: 12/12 tests passed (100%) after fixing MongoDB projection bug in /api/pulse/employees. Frontend: All features work correctly - Employee Profile loads with stats, Activity Timeline tabs work, Create Post dialog with @mention hint visible, author names are clickable links.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed MongoDB projection bug in /api/pulse/employees endpoint - was mixing inclusion and exclusion projections
All Employee Profile API endpoints working: GET /pulse/employees/{id}/profile, GET /pulse/employees/{id}/activity
Permissions endpoint returns correct permissions for superadmin role
@mention hint 'Type @ to mention someone' displays correctly in Create Post dialog
Author names in Pulse feed are clickable links to /pulse/employee/{id}
Activity Timeline tabs (All Activity, Posts, Recognitions, Updates) filter correctly
seed_data_creation: Test post created and deleted via API test (TEST_MentionPost)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pulse Phase 2 Employee Profile testing complete. Endpoints tested: GET /api/pulse/employees/{id}/profile, GET /api/pulse/employees/{id}/activity (with activity_type filter: posts, recognitions, updates), GET /api/pulse/permissions, GET /api/pulse/leadership/dashboard, GET /api/pulse/employees, GET /api/pulse/posts, POST /api/pulse/posts. Employee Profile page at /pulse/employee/:id shows stats (posts_count, recognitions_received, recognitions_given, daily_updates, weekly_updates, total_badges) and Activity Timeline with tabs. @mention hint visible in Create Post dialog. Author names in feed are clickable links.
